result:
I’d remove the human ability to dehumanize.

Not by forcing kindness, but by making it impossible to genuinely see another person as less than real—less feeling, less complex, less worthy of consideration. If everyone could, even briefly, experience the full inner life of the people affected by their choices, much of cruelty, exploitation, and indifference would probably collapse on its own.
